title: Guarantor-step required notices lack unit render pins (E2E-only coverage)
evidence:
guarantor.gleam renders four new conditional notice elements, e.g.:
          attribute("data-testid", "guarantor-required-notice-first-rental"),
          attribute("data-condition", "_guarantor_cohort"),
          attribute("data-condition-value", "first_rental"),
(and -student / -unemployed / guarantor-retired-hint variants). The new SSR test pins the driving synthetic but not the notice element:
pub fn never_rented_values_render_required_without_pretick_test() {
  let html = render([#("never_rented_before", "on")])
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_cohort", "first_rental") |> should.be_true
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_required", "on") |> should.be_true
  html |> synthetic("_guarantor_fields_open", "on") |> should.be_true
  html |> string.contains(checked_shape) |> should.be_false
}
grep across server/test/ and scripts/ for guarantor-required-notice|guarantor-retired-hint returns ZERO hits, while the sibling guarantor-ahead-note-* ARE unit-pinned in server/test/application/form_view_test.gleam. The testids appear only in .pi/skills/form-bug-hunt/scenarios/{stepper,validation}/*.yaml (E2E).
detail:
New conditional notice elements added in guarantor.gleam have no unit-level assertion of their data-condition wiring/presence; only the cohort synthetic they key off is pinned. A deleted notice

would pass all unit tests, caught only by E2E.
recommended_fix: In guarantor_section_test.gleam add string.contains assertions for data-testid="guarantor-required-notice-first-rental"|student|unemployed and guarantor-retired-hint in the relevant cohort renders, mirroring form_view_test's ahead-note pins.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: Coverage is comprehensive and exceeds thresholds. P0 100%: required-cohort validation matrix (application_handler_test: student/unemployed error, retired/employed pass, first-renter empty+partial), required-cohort persistence alignment (gdpr_integration_test: apply_submission_persists_guarantor_for_required_cohort_without_checkbox_test), optional desync kill (guarantor_section_test SSR pins + conditional-checkbox-desync/kept-on-error E2E). P1 >=90%: guarantor_required truth table, submit-time requirement statement (3 cohorts + precedence + fallback + retired-negative), any_guarantor_present, insert null-out, error_summary label/anchor, SSR two-path render (9 tests), form.js cohort module (5 node tests), prep/checklist copy (form_view_test + email_client_test invite/auto-reply). Overall ~95%. One P3 unit-pin gap on step-notices (E2E-covered) keeps P1 just under 100% but well above 90%.
recommended_fix: No action required to clear the gate. Optional: add the step-notice unit pins noted above to lift P1 to ~100% and harden against silent notice-element deletion.
